summary: This is a Docker development container configuration file that sets up a Docusaurus environment. It specifies which Dockerfile to use, names the container, and adds labels to organize it within a Docker Compose project.

explanations.4: The path ../Dockerfile tells Docker to look for the Dockerfile one directory level up from the current location, which contains the instructions for building this container image.
explanations.6: runArgs is a list of additional arguments that get passed to Docker when the container starts — these are options that customize how the container runs.
explanations.8: The label is metadata (like a tag) that Docker uses to organize and identify containers; this one marks the container as part of the 'blog-devcontainer' project.
